description: Create a new subscriber list. Lists are public by default: public lists appear to subscribers in the email preference center, where they can join or leave them. Set isPrivate to keep the list internal.

allowMemberUnsubscribe.description: Allow existing private-list members to unsubscribe in email preferences. Defaults false on creation; omission preserves on update, false disables. No effect on public lists. Does not allow joining or rejoining private lists.

companyId.description: Company ID to create the list in. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

isPrivate.description: Whether the list is private. Defaults false.

name: create_list

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_list` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

list.description: The list record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
